dataset_name: Fakeddit real Reddit image-text subset (community mirror)
label_definition: Source six-way label 0 (true) maps to REAL; labels 1-5 (satire, false connection, imposter, manipulated, misleading content) map to FAKE. Labels are inherited distant supervision, not new fact-checks or image-authenticity annotations.
scope: Supervised classification of the documented real-media corpus's inherited labels

encoder.timing_scope: Wall time for this extraction invocation including cache lookup and model loading; earlier interrupted invocations are excluded.
encoder.cache_key_inputs: encoder files + image file bytes / exact caption text; no labels or split names
encoder.extraction: local CLIP image/text encoders on supplied natural-media files
limitations: Input-to-embedding correspondence is supplied by the embedding provider and has not been independently re-encoded.

fit.head: L2 logistic regression
fit.text_model: train-fitted TF-IDF unigram/bigram features with L2 logistic regression
